pr_title: Use `static_assertions` to check for trait impls
pr_body:
# Objective

- Tests are manually checking whether derived types implement certain traits. (Specifically in `bevy_reflect.)
- #11182 introduces [`static_assertions`](https://docs.rs/static_assertions/) to automatically check this.
- Simplifies `Reflect` test in #11195.
- Closes #11196.

## Solution

- Add `static_assertions` and replace current tests.

---

I wasn't sure whether to remove the existing test or not. What do you think?
pr_comments:
Awesome! I'll remove the TODO comments.

I'm going to check if any other crates use the same `should_impl` test style, and I'll fix CI too.
@cBournhonesque, have time for a quick review?
I couldn't find any other tests that would work for this. As long as CI passes, I think this is ready to merge. :)

issue_context.title: Use static_assertions crate for asserting that types impl Reflect
issue_context.body:
You might want to swap to the strategy in https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/pull/11182 for all of our reflection assertions in tests at some point.

_Originally posted by @alice-i-cecile in https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/pull/11195#pullrequestreview-1802351668_
            
            
https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/pull/11182 is the PR in question: very straightforward.

review_comments: shouldn't this still be in a test function? like the one before: `entity_hashmap_should_impl_reflect`

`assert_impl_all` actually expands to a `const`. ([See the source](https://docs.rs/static_assertions/latest/src/static_assertions/assert_impl.rs.html#113-121), it's not too complicated.) It can be used in either a function or a module.

The reason the other asserts are in functions are to group similar tests together. `assert_impl_all` doesn't need to be in `option_should_impl_enum`, but I thought it made the most sense this way.
Other static_assertions in bevy are similarly not inside a test function: https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/pull/11182/files#diff-99929377bff6c8e2987d61c8887213b22703c4e62e3d551d3243a1ecbf21869fR425
